stories.headline: AWS Quick adds Meta ads AI connector for natural-language campaign management

sources.title: Meta ads is now available in AWS Quick

stories.what_happened: AWS Quick now includes a Meta ads AI connector that lets Meta advertisers use natural language to create, manage, and analyze ad campaigns while staying linked to the Meta ad management network. The connector also enables combining Meta ad data with first- and third‑party sources to build dashboards, documents, slide decks, and automated workflows.
stories.why_it_matters: The feature lets advertisers operate Meta campaigns directly from AWS Quick, reducing the need for separate tools and simplifying data integration across sources. This can speed up reporting, improve insight generation, and support automated marketing processes within the AWS ecosystem.
